input.quality_summary: This PR adds Circle Onramp Kit integration to the fintech dashboard, enabling users to purchase USDC/EURC with fiat directly into wallets. The changes are well-documented with clear environment setup instructions and webhook configuration guidance, though the submission excerpt is truncated and doesn't show the full implementation.
reasons: Adds meaningful capability: onramp feature enables a real user workflow (fiat-to-crypto purchases) that was previously missing
Substantial scope: 2366 additions across 22 files indicates comprehensive integration
Good documentation: environment variables are clearly explained with sandbox/production warnings, README updated with setup steps and feature description
Webhook integration properly documented: explains the need to enable onramp.deposit.settled in Circle Console
Quality concern: submission content is truncated (ends mid-line in README), so full code quality cannot be assessed
Merged status confirms acceptance by maintainers
Private dependency management handled appropriately with .npmrc scope mapping to avoid breaking CI
